description: Source code for CacheTracker class managing cache statistics, quota, and file system traversal in Android installd component.

classes.name: CacheTracker
classes.description: Manages cache usage, quota, and file system traversal for Android's installd component.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of cache usage and quota.

methods.name: addDataPath
methods.description: Adds a data path to be tracked.

methods.name: loadStats
methods.description: Loads cache statistics, including quota and tree size.

methods.name: loadQuotaStats
methods.description: Loads quota-related cache usage if supported.

methods.name: loadItemsFrom
methods.description: Loads cache items from a specified filesystem path.

methods.name: loadItems
methods.description: Loads all cache items from data paths.

methods.name: ensureItems
methods.description: Ensures cache items are loaded, avoiding reloading if already loaded.

methods.name: getCacheRatio
methods.description: Calculates cache usage ratio as a percentage.
